Understanding Refusals Review Options Common Factors Our Approach FAQ Understanding Refusals A refusal is a decision — not always a conclusion. When an application is refused, the decision record explains the grounds. Understanding those reasons precisely is the first, essential step — it determines whether a review pathway exists and how a fresh case should be framed. Some refusals can be reviewed by an independent body; others are better addressed through a new, strengthened application. We map your occupation, maximise your points, and steer your EOI from skill assessment to invitation. 189 / 190 / 491 Core GSM subclasses 65+ Points to enter the pool What is GSM Pathway Points Test Subclass 189 Subclass 190 Subclass 491 Compare FAQ A New Life in Australia Permanent residence — and the freedom to build your future anywhere in Australia. The Foundation What is General Skilled Migration? General Skilled Migration (GSM) is the umbrella for Australia’s permanent and provisional visas awarded to skilled workers on the basis of merit — not an employer or family sponsor. Selection runs through a single, transparent points-tested system administered via SkillSelect. You lodge an Expression of Interest (EOI), score points against fixed criteria, and the Department of Home Affairs issues invitations to the highest-ranking candidates in periodic invitation rounds. A positive skills assessment for your nominated occupation is the gateway to the entire program. Truvia’s role is strategic: we identify the subclass and state that best fit your profile, then engineer your claim to extract every legitimate point available. Our experts guide you through the right program for your profile and occupation. Express Entry PNP AIP & RCIP Canada's Most Popular Pathway Express Entry Canada's flagship points-based immigration system. IRCC holds regular draws and invites the highest-scoring candidates — across three federal programs — to apply for permanent residence. 3 Federal programs CRS Points scoring system PR Permanent residence Three Programs Under Express Entry FSW Federal Skilled Worker For professionals with foreign skilled work experience. The most widely used Express Entry stream globally. Foreign experience accepted → FST Federal Skilled Trades For qualified tradespeople — electricians, plumbers, welders, and certified skilled trades in high demand across Canada.
